newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel says Arafat ready to restore coordination.
newsitem.headline: Israel says Arafat ready to restore coordination.

text.p: Israeli President Ezer Weizman said after meeting Yasser Arafat on Tuesday that the Palestinian president had agreed to renew security coordination with the Jewish state after a seven-week crisis in peacemaking.

But Palestinian leaders said nothing had been resolved at only the second high-level Israel-PLO contact in nearly two months and clarified that security meetings would only be held with U.S. representatives present.

"The most important issue for me is that...he will do everything so that security will be okay and he will bring about a resumption of talks between security chiefs of the Palestinian Authority and our security chiefs," Weizman told a news conference after meeting Arafat at Israel's border with Gaza.
"This point was agreed upon. I hope that it will begin operating within a few days," he said.
Israel has said peacemaking could only resume once Palestinians renewed high-level security contacts with the Jewish state and cracked down on guerrilla violence.
Arafat stopped short of declaring a resumption of security meetings.
"I totally respect your insistence on this issue. God willing, both of us will try to continue on this path," Arafat told reporters.
Palestinians said their demand that Israel halt construction on a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem -- the issue that spawned the crisis -- had not been resolved.

"None of the basic issues were resolved during the meeting. We clarified and insisted during the meeting that resumption of negotiations will not take place before full cessation of all settlement activities," Palestinian Authority member Yasser Abed Rabbo told Reuter.
"As for security coordination, Weizman insisted on restoring coordination. We have agreed on meetings at the security level that will be attended by the Americans," he said.
Weizman's presidential role in Israel is largely symbolic but officials said his meeting with Arafat was coordinated with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
Palestinian have turned to Weizman in the past to press the right-wing Netanyahu to show flexibility.
